name: AppLovin MAX
what_it_is: An ad mediation product from AppLovin for monetizing mobile apps, documented in the AppLovin Support Center.
platforms: Android, Fire OS and iOS apps
pricing: Fees are not stated on the opened documentation pages.

facts.fact: AppLovin's getting-started guide shows how to monetize a mobile app with MAX in seven steps and lets you add apps on Android, Fire OS or iOS.
The guide says MAX supports many networks across bidding and traditional connections, and unsupported networks can be mediated through a custom SDK connection that AppLovin cannot troubleshoot.
The guide says AppLovin pays you directly for impressions served from the AppLovin Exchange or AppLovin's Ads Manager.
The payment FAQ lists direct deposit or ACH, wire transfer, check and PayPal as payment methods, and says impressions served through Google Open Bidding are paid by Google.
The guide notes AppLovin is not part of the Families Self Certified Ads SDK Program.
